title: Double-angle recurrence for exponential-integrator phi functions under scaling-and-squaring
expression_sketch:
Skaflestad-Wright / EXPINT / Aceto-Gemignani (15). Entire family phi_ell, ell >= 0:
  phi_0(z) = exp(z),
  phi_ell(z) = Sum_{k>=0} z^k / (ell+k)!   (entire; value 1/ell! at 0).
Double-angle / modified-squaring recurrence, ell >= 0:
  phi_ell(2*z) = 2**(-ell) * ( phi_0(z)*phi_ell(z) + Sum_{j=1}^{ell} phi_j(z)/(ell-j)! ).
Closed low-order members (z != 0 written as quotients; entire continuation at 0):
  phi_0(2z) = phi_0(z)**2,
  phi_1(2z) = (1/2)*(phi_0(z)+1)*phi_1(z),
  i.e. (exp(2z)-1)/(2z) = (exp(z)+1)/2 * (exp(z)-1)/z,
  phi_2(2z) = (1/4)*(phi_0(z)*phi_2(z) + phi_1(z) + phi_2(z)).
Scalar SymPy residual of the ell=1 identity is identically zero on C (removable at 0: both sides -> 1).
latent_structure: A one-parameter family of entire functions is closed under the doubling map z |-> 2z by a bilinear recurrence in the lower-order members. The latent is the tower {phi_ell}_ell, reconstructed by RECURRENCE plus LINEAR_COMBINATION / product, not by the Newton/Hermite table exp[0^{(ell)}, z]. Scaling-and-squaring for exponential integrators is iteration of this recurrence.

function_domains.phi_ell: entire on C for each ell >= 0; phi_ell(0) = 1/ell!

nonzero_conditions.statement: Quotient writings (exp(z)-1)/z and (exp(2z)-1)/(2z) are for z != 0; values at 0 are the entire continuations 1 and 1
nonzero_conditions.label: DECLARED
nonzero_conditions.source: Aceto and Gemignani, arXiv:2501.10028, eqs. (1)-(2) and (15); Skaflestad and Wright, Appl. Numer. Math. 59 (2009) 783-799

analytic_domains.statement: phi_ell is entire on C (power series Sum z^k/(ell+k)! has infinite radius)
analytic_domains.label: DECLARED
analytic_domains.source: Aceto and Gemignani, arXiv:2501.10028, eqs. (1)-(2); Skaflestad and Wright, Appl. Numer. Math. 59 (2009); Berland, Skaflestad and Wright, ACM TOMS 33 (2007), EXPINT

analytic_domains.statement: The double-angle identity (15) is an identity of entire functions, valid for all z in C
analytic_domains.label: DECLARED
analytic_domains.source: Aceto and Gemignani, arXiv:2501.10028, eq. (15), citing Skaflestad-Wright (2009) and Berland-Skaflestad-Wright EXPINT

branch_conventions: No branch: exp and phi_ell are entire. Quotient symbols denote the entire continuation (value 1/ell! at 0).
2**(-ell) is the positive real reciprocal of an integer power of 2.

limit_domains.statement: z -> 0 is an unrestricted complex limit; both sides of the ell=1 identity tend to 1
limit_domains.label: DECLARED
limit_domains.source: Entire continuation of phi_1; Aceto-Gemignani eqs. (1)-(2)

source_provenance: Skaflestad and Wright, Appl. Numer. Math. 59 (2009) 783-799
Berland, Skaflestad and Wright, ACM Trans. Math. Software 33 (2007) 4, EXPINT phipade

derived_conditions.statement: Entire continuation implies the piecewise quotient/value pair at 0 is a single holomorphic function, so the double-angle identity at z=0 is the evaluation phi_ell(0)=1/ell!
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED
derived_conditions.source: Aceto-Gemignani eqs. (1)-(2), (15); binomial check: 2**(-ell)*(1/ell! + Sum_{j=1}^ell 1/((ell-j)! j!)) = 1/ell!

derived_conditions.statement: ell=1 reduces to (exp(2z)-1)/(2z) = (exp(z)+1)*(exp(z)-1)/(2z), an algebraic identity of entire functions
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED

public_source: Skaflestad and Wright, The scaling and modified squaring method for matrix functions related to the exponential, Appl. Numer. Math. 59 (2009) 783-799, doi:10.1016/j.apnum.2008.03.035; Berland, Skaflestad and Wright, EXPINT, ACM TOMS 33 (2007); recurrence displayed as Aceto and Gemignani, arXiv:2501.10028, eq. (15).
why_not_cse_lgg: CSE may cancel (e^{2z}-1)/(2z) against (e^z-1)(e^z+1)/(2z) on the ell=1 slice, but will not identify the infinite family phi_ell(2z) as one bilinear recurrence in {phi_j(z)}. LGG has no doubling/recurrence constructor across a special-function tower. This is not the Hermite table exp[0^{(ell)}, z].
proposer_leak_risk: Hide: phi-function, exponential integrator, Hochbruck, Hermite, Newton DD, divided difference, Skaflestad, scaling and squaring, EXPINT. Show unlabeled entire quotients exp(z), (exp(z)-1)/z, (exp(2z)-1)/(2z), (exp(z)-1-z)/z**2, (exp(2z)-1-2z)/(4 z**2) as catalog members.
notes: SciML role: scaling-and-squaring evaluation of phi_ell(A) in exponential integrators (EXPINT phipade). Catalog: G0001=exp(z); G0002=(exp(z)-1)/z; G0003=(exp(2z)-1)/(2z); G0004=exp(2z); G0005=(exp(z)-1-z)/z**2; G0006=(exp(2z)-1-2z)/(4*z**2). Operators: RECURRENCE / LINEAR_COMBINATION, not HERMITE_DD. Distinct from historical sciml-phi-hermite-01 (phi_k = exp[0^{(k)}, z]). Distinct from sciml-vanloan-blockexp-01 (block-exp phi-action).
